column1: Traffic reports will resume on Monday, June 9 at 6:30 a.m.

column3: Long Term Lane Closure on Leestown Road:
column4: Closure scheduled to start on Monday, June 9 at 8 a.m. for work on the New Circle Road widening project.

column3: Long Term Lane Closure on Leestown Road:
column4: The inbound right lane of Leestown Road will be closed between Greendale Road and New Circle Road.

column3: Long Term Lane Closure on Leestown Road:
column4: The closure is expected to last for a few weeks and will allow for pipe work and excavation.

column3: Long Term Lane Closure on Leestown Road:
column4: Motorists should expect long delays if traveling in this area.
